claims.reason: The positive-density interface transformation preserves the lifted phase, with D targets n*pi and N targets (n-1/2)*pi. Independent checks covered constant spectra, integer and half-integer interface levels, first modes, prefix equality, default versus explicit D, and the legacy roots_of call. Independent 85-digit transfer calculations and interior-zero counts verified 48 layered modes; maximum frequency relative error was 2.36e-16. Tested unresolved endpoints, optical underflow, frequency/eigenvalue overflow, eigenvalue underflow, excessive winding and insufficient refinement raised explicit errors. Phase records correctly remain uncertified numerical diagnostics.

Tables bind copied binary64 geometry, boundary condition and indexed eigenvalues; supported field assignment is frozen, nested records are tuples, and returned prefixes are detached. The legacy zero-based pole argument is converted to a one-based identity and checked against the target and requested prefix. Independent tests rejected geometry/BC mismatches, incorrect targets or poles, insufficient tables, retained and out-of-prefix near poles, uncovered full targets and invalid coordinates. Ninety-six constant-density finite-sum comparisons, including endpoints and nonpositive targets, agreed within 3.34e-16. Main-call and targeted legacy-call wiring uses the appropriate shared tables and pole indices. Both supplied suites passed 136 checks, including under -O.

Executed both half-problem CLIs, both rawko CLIs and all four fixed green-inertia cases, inspecting numerical output. At n=2, R=4, raw Ko agreed with physical edge finite differences within 4.38e-10; cross-parity KpOdd agreed with E Ke E from finite differences within 4.49e-10. Matching-truncation comparisons passed for n=2,3 and both branches. Independent full-matrix assembly and projection of H/E summands agreed with all corresponding sector keys within 5.44e-13; legacy c_e/c_o metadata correctly identifies conjugated summands. Full spectral routines retain N+1 modes, which was matched explicitly. Visible spectral tails were distinguished from algebraic identities. All 15 snapshot hashes matched and remained unchanged; recorded project imports came exclusively from isolated copies. Execution logs, module origins, hashes and independent test sources/results are preserved at /mnt/f/tools/math-audit-round12-20260926/software-review2er/stateless-z6t8ur9y.

limitations: Approval covers the declared software behavior and finite numerical review only; it does not establish complete formalization, certified error bounds, universal floating-point correctness or an infinite-dimensional Green identity.

The historical debug2/debug3 main routines were not executed, as excluded by scope. Their imports, changed table/pole wiring and targeted calls were checked; large quadrature routines and deprecated NumPy calls remain unvalidated.
Other historical scans, global signs, all-R inertia and uniqueness claims were not revalidated.
No earlier implementation snapshot was supplied. Default D compatibility was checked through current signatures, legacy calls and default-versus-explicit-D results.
